assets: The corpus store (documents, chunks, embeddings, research tables)
The HTTP, socket, and MCP API surfaces
The migrate-data swap tool and its source and target databases
attackerControlledInputs: HTTP API request bodies and query parameters (src/corpus_kb/api)
URLs submitted to website ingestion (corpus-kb ingest-url)
trustBoundaries: Operator configuration (config.yaml, CLI flags, environment, DSNs) is operator-owned and is not attacker-controlled
Database catalog names, migration table plans, and corpus identifiers are operator-scoped storage metadata
src/corpus_kb/ui_dist is generated build output; the reviewed source of truth is ui_src
Tests and research probes run on operator machines only. Their fake credentials and probe URLs are not product attack surface
securityInvariants: Attacker-controlled queries go through bind parameters only
DDL and PRAGMA statements interpolate only validated and quoted operator values (storage.sql_ident)
Outbound fetches default to loopback hosts; remote rerank endpoints are opt-in (allow_remote_urls)
